---
name: Feature Request 🚀
about: Suggest an idea for VASA Mission Control
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'feature-request']
assignees: ''

---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## 💡 Problem/Motivation
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 🎯 Proposed Solution
**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Implementation Details
**For developers: Technical implementation ideas**
- [ ] Frontend changes required
- [ ] Backend API changes required  
- [ ] Discord bot changes required
- [ ] Database schema changes required
- [ ] Authentication/security considerations

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups
If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples of the desired UI/UX.

## 🎯 User Stories
**As a [type of user], I want [goal] so that [benefit].**

Examples:
- As a server admin, I want to bulk import events so that I can save time setting up recurring meetings
- As a user, I want email notifications so that I don't miss important events

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The feature should...
- [ ] The feature must not...
- [ ] The feature could optionally...

## 🔗 Related Issues
Link any related issues, PRs, or discussions.

## 📊 Priority
- [ ] Low - Nice to have
- [ ] Medium - Would improve user experience  
- [ ] High - Critical for core functionality
- [ ] Urgent - Blocking other development

## 🧪 Testing Requirements
How should this feature be tested?
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests  
- [ ] Manual testing scenarios
- [ ] Performance testing

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
